fix_code:
def main():
    N = int(input())
    Q = list(map(int, input().split()))
    A = list(map(int, input().split()))
    B = list(map(int, input().split()))
    max_servings = 0

    for servings_A in range(min(Q[i] // A[i] if A[i] != 0 else float('inf') for i in range(N)) + 1):
        remaining_Q = [Q[i] - servings_A * A[i] for i in range(N)]
        servings_B = min(remaining_Q[i] // B[i] if B[i] != 0 else float('inf') for i in range(N))
        total_servings = servings_A + servings_B
        max_servings = max(max_servings, total_servings)

    print(max_servings)
